info.title: fastllm-proxy
info.description:
Two listeners, and they are not interchangeable.

The **data plane** (default :4000) is the OpenAI-compatible gateway: point clients here.

The **admin API** (default :4001) serves `/admin/*`, the management UI, and the control-plane protocol (`/snapshot`, `/usage`) that proxy replicas speak. `/snapshot` returns *decrypted* upstream credentials to anything holding the proxy token, which is why it must never share an address with the gateway.

Generated from the router and checked against it by `tests/openapi.rs`, so a route added without a spec entry fails the build.

apiKey.description: A key minted through the admin API. Authorised per model.

session.name: fastllm_session
session.description: Set by POST /login. Each route additionally requires a permission the principal holds through a role.

proxyToken.description: --proxy-token. Machine-to-machine only; never a human credential.
